summary: Permission Groups / Presets (inline-safe — migration 0007 is two additive CreateModels only). Adds reusable permission presets built on Django's native auth.Group: staff with the new dlux.manage_groups permission can define a named bundle of permissions once (optionally scoped) and reuse it. Users can be added to presets from the creation/permissions forms (a new preset selector layered above the direct-permission checkboxes) or from a dedicated Manage Groups modal in user management, which also lists each preset's members with who assigned them and when. Membership is live — editing a preset's permissions propagates to every member via native group inheritance, so existing user.has_perm checks are unchanged and users in no preset are entirely unaffected. New models GroupProfile (hosts the manage_groups permission) + GroupMembership. This release also folds in the previously-unreleased v1.2.15 frontend work — Options landing-page/public-root polish and Redis/Celery System Info diagnostics — plus a batch of dark-theme contrast fixes (permission cards now theme-aware on every dark theme, aether modal text and per-column table-header gradient, password-rules checklist) and the activity-log tab-count fix; all inline-safe.
